summary:
Our project is called Unstable Quasars which is an interactive space survival game that challenges young astronauts to survive on a fictional planet while managing environmental hazards such as dust storms, radiation, fluctuating oxygen levels and limited water supplies.

Players must monitor survival variables, make strategic decisions and use innovative inventions, including a water collector, radiation shield and magnetic brush, to overcome challenges and stay alive.

By combining science, technology and interactive gameplay, our project encourages critical thinking, problem-solving and creativity while teaching players about the challenges of space exploration. Our goal is to inspire the next generation of astronauts through an engaging and educational adventure.
